note: Set B is better because it correctly binds science instrument counts to specific mission names (e.g., LUVOIR-A, LUVOIR-B), whereas Set A often uses vague or corrupted entities like 'n-axis telescope' or 'axis telescope'. Both sets incorrectly label the Lynx 10 m focal length as a 'dimension' or 'size' in some claims, but Set A makes this error twice while Set B makes it once. Set A also includes more vague entity extractions like 'baseline mission spacecraft'.
